title: Quantum correction to the diffusion term in stochastic inflation from composite-operator matching in Soft de Sitter Effective Theory
summary: In the framework of Soft de Sitter Effective Theory (SdSET), the Fokker-Planck equation for the late-time dynamics of the massless minimally coupled scalar field and its extension to the Kramers-Moyal equation are obtained from operator mixing of composite operators of the effective superhorizon field. We construct the formalism for composite-operator renormalisation, mixing and matching in dimensional regularisation, allowing for computations beyond the leading order.
